name: aws_mq_broker
description: Creates an Amazon MQ broker for managed message broker service supporting ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ.

engine_version.name: engine_version
engine_version.description: The version of the broker engine. E.g., 5.17.6 for ActiveMQ.

deployment_mode.name: deployment_mode
deployment_mode.description: The deployment mode of the broker.

publicly_accessible.name: publicly_accessible
publicly_accessible.description: Whether to enable connections from applications outside of the VPC.

security_groups.name: security_groups
security_groups.description: List of security group IDs for VPC-deployed brokers.

subnet_ids.name: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: List of subnet IDs for VPC-deployed brokers (one subnet for SINGLE_INSTANCE, two for multi-AZ).

auto_minor_version_upgrade.name: auto_minor_version_upgrade
auto_minor_version_upgrade.description: Whether to automatically upgrade to new minor versions of the broker.

apply_immediately.name: apply_immediately
apply_immediately.description: Specifies whether any broker modifications are applied immediately.
